requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6026-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6026-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

129-1409-4289-7060.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2292-3249-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
2292-3249-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

186-1017-7426-7628.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
186-1017-7426-7628.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Heartstone and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

500-1181-3191-6913.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Chameleon and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Chameleon dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Chameleon tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1181-3191-6913.notes: You can forego casting Sacrifice if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

2034-4679-6821-7220.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Glamermite.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Glamermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

176-3000-3967.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-3000-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

1369-3814-7086.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1369-3814-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Argothian Elder.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Argothian Elder's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Argothian Elder's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4352-5147-6972--112.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
4352-5147-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3025-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-2593-5089.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-3652-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

222-2060-2292-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 4 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2060-2292-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2060-2292-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-2794-4613.description:
Activate Trelasarra by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Trelasarra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

678-5070-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-5070-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the creature's toughness
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
678-5070-5670.notes: If the creature has toughness 2 or greater, this combo will net infinite lifegain.

2239-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Ardent Elementalist each turn.
2239-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Ardent Elementalist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1018-2061-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
1018-2061-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1561-3862.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a library size which is larger than or equal to their life total.
1561-3862.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, targeting an opponent whose library size is larger than or equal to their life total.
Resolve Peer into the Abyss, causing that opponent to draw cards equal to half their library size and causing them to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card drawn, dealing 1 damage to the opponent for each card drawn this way and putting that many +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1642-2682-4705.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least three.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-2682-4705.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the second Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

914-1703-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1703-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {U}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Repeat.

885-4747-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Alena.
Alena does not have summoning sickness.
A creature with power four or greater has entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
885-4747-5200.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Alena.
Repeat.
